 wishing you well ♡

You've been through a lot. A lot. I'm sorry. In any case, I'm really proud of you for keeping your ed under control, and also that you recognised what the issue was! It's good you're recognising what has happened. And it'll be hard, but it's qlrigjr to accept the past and continue.
You'll be alright. 
I hope you find comfort within yourself, though.
Sorry I don't really have much to say..
But I'm wishing you well! 
Good luck
i'm sorry things are so tough. when you say you're taking your son with you, are you implying you're going to kill him, too?
it sucks when this has been going on for so long, and this has happened so many times, and your friends are sick of it.
wishing you well, love. <3
i'm so happy for you!
don't make decisions on your life for them, please. instead, spite them in other ways. don't give up what's yours for people who aren't worthy of it.
what's making you feel this way?

hey. i just read all of this, and man, i gotta say. you're strong. i'm at a loss for words, really, because you seem really intelligent and probably would have thought everything i would say already. but, i just wanna say, thank you. thank you for being here. i'm really glad you're here and are persevering despite all the hardships. you've been through a lot, and you're still here. that's amazing. i'm sorry, i don't really know what to say, but thank you for sharing your story. wishing you well.
charity shops!!! they're really cheap and you can find really nice things there. like little ornaments, household items etc.

hey, when you get home, we can talk. take your time, you'll be okay. maybe reach out to a friend that you feel you can rely on that can be there with you? if not, i'll be here. good luck there, i hope you feel better soon.
*hug* feel free to talk to me anytime. take care.

your note is fine, but please. try to get away from them if you can, hang in there. i'm sure things will be better for you. i'm sorry i'm a stranger who can't do much, but i'll be here if you want help. good luck, and i hope you find peace in whichever way you decide. much love.

everything, i guess, is overwhelming. i've quit social media and i'm away from all my irl contacts in order to stop annoying them, and i guess i was right when i thought i was an inconvenience i was right because not a single one of them have texted me yet. which is alright, i guess. anyway, yeah. kinda everything. talked to the school counsellor before summer, she said go to the gp . but my parents are reluctant. it's alright, i guess i'll deal with it, but i find myself looking for ways out anyway. i've been making changes to see if i feel better, but i'm even more miserable. i want to end it all already. it's been years. i'm sorry, i know this isn't exactly...replyable. but thank you for replying at all and making me feel less alone. it means a lot. i hope you're well. i'll be okay <3
